author: Eli the Computer Guy
description:
Free In Person Tech Eduction in Baltimore MD - https://www.meetup.com/eli-the-computer-guy/

This class is going to be an overview of the different systems that are required to build AI projects. LLM's and such are only one component of an overall intelligent system, You need the rest of the "tech stack" to build a product that can actually be used to solve problems.

We'll discuss computer and the difference between CPU's, GPU's and TPU's.

We'll talk about database systems for storing data that the application can use and what RAG and vector databases are.

We'll go over API calls so that you understand how to bring data into your project from outside sources.

We'll go over the concepts for file storage so that your intelligent application can both access and save files that are created.

And will give an overview of Cloud Architecture and how AWS, Azure and Local systems can work together for resiliency and reliability.
